cards.title: Discrete thermalizing collisional map
cards.latex: \rho_{t_{n+1}} = \mathcal{E}_{t_n}(\rho_{t_n}) = (1-P_{\mathrm{th}})\,U_{t_n}\rho_{t_n}U_{t_n}^{\dagger} + P_{\mathrm{th}}\,\rho^{\mathrm{eq}}_{s_n},\quad P_{\mathrm{th}} = 1-e^{-\gamma_0\delta t},\ U_{t_n}=e^{-iH_{t_n}\delta t},\ \rho^{\mathrm{eq}}_{s_n}=\frac{e^{-\beta H_{t_n}}}{\mathrm{Tr}\,e^{-\beta H_{t_n}}}
cards.role: Simulation engine: CPTP evolution of the driven reservoir between injections; thermodynamically consistent (Gibbs state invariant since [U, rho_eq] = 0).
derived_from: Davies-Lindblad global master equation (SI I), repeated-interaction collision model

checks.reason: trace preservation and positivity on random states (verify_formulas.py::check_map_cptp)

cards.numerical_form: Per step: eigendecompose H (2^L x 2^L Hermitian), build U and rho_eq from the same eigenbasis, apply convex combination.

cards.title: Mackey-Glass drive generation and preprocessing
cards.role: Chaotic classical input; RK4 integration, transient discarded, sampled every 3 time units, linearly rescaled to [-1,1]; approx zero mean, sigma_s^2 ~= 0.11, spectral peak omega_s ~= 0.36.

checks.reason: generated ensemble is near zero-mean with stationary variance and low-frequency spectral peak (verify_formulas.py::check_mg_stats)

cards.numerical_form: RK4 with dt_int = 0.1 and delay buffer; sequences centered and linearly scaled to the paper's stated ensemble variance sigma_s^2 = 0.11 (support within [-1,1]).
open_questions: The verbal preprocessing ('linearly rescaled to [-1,1]') is inconsistent with the stated statistics: a min-max rescale gives mean 0.14 and variance 0.24, not ~0 and ~0.11. We calibrate the affine map to the published statistics (center; scale to sigma_s^2 = 0.11; max|s| ~ 0.77 < 1). Initial conditions and integration step are also unpublished; random constant initial histories in [0.8, 1.6] are used.

cards.title: Holevo memory capacity and relative-entropy recast
cards.role: Historical information dynamically retained about the current drive s_n; estimated by binning states by s_n (Methods Eqs. 20-21, B=50).

checks.reason: S(rho_bar) - sum P S(rho) equals expected relative entropy on random ensembles (verify_formulas.py::check_holevo_recast)

cards.numerical_form: chi_m = S(rho_bar) - sum_b P_b S(rho_b) with eigenvalue truncation 1e-12; rho_b = bin-averaged density matrix keyed by s_n.

cards.title: Holevo predictive capacity
cards.role: Statistical correlation between the reservoir state and the upcoming target s_{n+1}; same estimator with bins keyed by s_{n+1}. Marginalization consistency (Eq. 7/S8-S9) guarantees the same unconditional average.

checks.reason: memory-binned and predictive-binned averages reconstruct the same unconditional state in simulation (verify_formulas.py::check_marginalization)

cards.numerical_form: Identical to EQC003 with bin key s_{n+1}.

cards.title: Quantum informational dissipation (QID)
cards.role: Non-predictive historical information structurally retained by the reservoir; definition.
cards.numerical_form: Difference of the two estimated capacities per step; accumulated over N_eval steps for chi_d_tot.

cards.title: Coherence decomposition of the Holevo quantity
cards.latex: \chi = \mathcal{I} + \mathcal{C},\quad \mathcal{I} = S[\Delta(\bar\rho)] - \sum_x P(x) S[\Delta(\rho_x)],\quad \mathcal{C} = \sum_x P(x) C(\rho_x) - C(\bar\rho),\quad C(\rho) = S[\Delta(\rho)] - S(\rho)
cards.role: Splits capacities into classical mutual information (diagonal populations) and ensemble coherence (off-diagonal interference); dephasing basis = sigma^z product basis in which H1 is diagonal.
derived_from: relative entropy of coherence; linearity of the dephasing map (S54-S55)

checks.reason: chi = I + C and C >= 0, chi >= I on random ensembles (verify_formulas.py::check_coherence_split)

cards.numerical_form: Delta(rho) = diagonal part in computational basis; I and C from binned ensembles.

cards.title: QID split into classical and coherent dissipation
cards.role: Splits QID into population dissipation and coherent dissipation; the shared baseline C(rho_bar) cancels because both ensembles average to the same state.

checks.reason: chi_d = D_c + D_q on paired random ensembles sharing one average state (verify_formulas.py::check_qid_split)

cards.numerical_form: Assembled from the same binned conditional states as EQC006.

cards.title: Macroscopic injection work from conditional ensembles
cards.role: Average quench work of the signal injection, expressed through the same conditional states used for the capacities; enables macroscopic evaluation without trajectory unraveling.
derived_from: microscopic quench work averaged over trajectories, conditioned via the probability product rule
cards.numerical_form: Energy expectations of binned states against the instantaneous Hamiltonians; H_{t_{n+1}} uses the bin's own s_{n+1} value.

cards.title: Per-step identity: irreversible injection work equals QID
cards.role: Central identity: energetic terms cancel exactly between W and Delta F, leaving a purely entropic penalty equal to the QID. Machine-checkable in simulation because both sides are algebra on the same binned states.
derived_from: non-equilibrium free energy F(rho) = Tr(rho H) - S(rho)/beta

checks.reason: beta*W_irr == chi_d to machine precision on random ensemble pairs sharing an average (verify_formulas.py::check_work_identity); re-derived independently in DERIVATION_TRACE.md

cards.numerical_form: Checked each simulation step as a consistency invariant.

cards.title: Generalized Landauer bound and non-negative relaxation dissipation
cards.role: Fig. 2b content: cumulative irreversible work upper-bounds accumulated QID; relaxation term non-negative by monotonicity of relative entropy under the CPTP map with invariant Gibbs state.
derived_from: data-processing inequality for quantum relative entropy

checks.reason: S(E(rho)||rho_eq) <= S(rho||rho_eq) for the collisional map on random states (verify_formulas.py::check_relax_nonneg)

cards.numerical_form: W_relax accumulated from relative entropies of binned states vs instantaneous Gibbs states; W_irr_tot = sum(chi_d + beta*W_relax).

cards.title: BKM geometric expansion and analytic capacities
cards.latex: S(\bar\rho + \lambda\delta\rho\,\|\,\bar\rho) \approx \frac{\lambda^2}{2} g^{\bar\rho}_{\mathrm{BKM}}(\delta\rho,\delta\rho),\quad g_{\mathrm{BKM}} = \sum_{j,k} |(\delta\rho)_{jk}|^2 \frac{\ln p_j - \ln p_k}{p_j - p_k};\quad \chi^{\mathrm{m}} \approx \frac{\lambda^2}{2}\Big[\beta\sum_{j\ne k} G(\Delta E_{jk}) \frac{p_k - p_j}{E_j - E_k} F_{jk} |\langle j|H_1|k\rangle|^2 + \beta^2 P_{\mathrm{th}}^2 \sum_j G(0)\, p_j |\langle j|H_1 - \langle H_1\rangle_0|j\rangle|^2\Big]
cards.role: Analytical linear-response capacity used to explain the critical peak (Eq. 17); g_jk = (1-P_th)exp(-i Delta E_jk dt), F_jk = |1-g_jk|^2.

checks.reason: S(rho_bar + lambda*drho || rho_bar) matches (lambda^2/2) g_BKM to O(lambda^3) on random states (verify_formulas.py::check_bkm_quadratic)

cards.numerical_form: Evaluated in the H0 eigenbasis with thermal populations; G estimated from the drive statistics.

cards.title: Dynamic accumulation factor and spectral resonance peak
cards.latex: G(\Delta E_{jk}) \approx \frac{1}{\sigma_s^2}\Big|\sum_{\tau=0}^{\infty} C_a(\tau) g_{jk}^{\tau}\Big|^2,\quad C_a(\tau) \approx \sigma_s^2 \cos(\omega_s\tau\delta t) e^{-\gamma_s\tau\delta t},\quad G(\omega_s) \approx \frac{\sigma_s^2}{4(P_{\mathrm{th}} + \gamma_s\delta t)^2}
cards.role: Frequency-selective filter of the input sequence; resonance Delta E_jk = omega_s explains the critical computational peak (Fig. S1a). With paper values (P_th ~= 0.095, gamma_s dt ~= 0.015, sigma_s^2 ~= 0.11): G(omega_s) ~= 2.3.

checks.reason: geometric-series resonance sum reproduces sigma_s^2/(4(P_th+gamma_s dt)^2) ~= 2.3 with paper constants (verify_formulas.py::check_g_peak)

cards.numerical_form: G(omega) evaluated from the Lorentzian C_a and directly from binned sequence statistics (S43) for Fig. S1a.

cards.title: Reservoir architectures: disordered TFIM and augmented cluster model
cards.latex: H_0^{\mathrm{TFIM}} = \sum_{i>j} J_{ij}\sigma^z_i\sigma^z_j + h\sum_i \sigma^x_i,\ h=1,\ J_{ij}\sim U[-J/2,J/2];\quad H_0^{\mathrm{cluster}} = -J_{zz}\sum_i \sigma^z_i\sigma^z_{i+1} - h_x\sum_i \sigma^x_i + J_{zxz}\sum_i \sigma^z_{i-1}\sigma^x_i\sigma^z_{i+1},\ J_{zz}=0.1,\ J_{zxz}=(1-J_{zz})\alpha,\ h_x=(1-J_{zz})(1-\alpha)
cards.role: The two reservoir Hamiltonians; TFIM has an ergodic-to-MBL crossover in J, the cluster model a symmetry-protected topological transition at alpha ~= 0.5. Boundary condition: open chain, fixed by the PBC duality symmetry argument and the Fig. S1c spectral fingerprint.

checks.reason: main text p. 7 and Fig. 2 caption
cluster-model spectral gap minimizes near alpha = 0.5 at L = 6 (verify_formulas.py::check_cluster_gap)

Boundary condition resolved to OBC: under PBC the CZ-duality H(alpha)->H(1-alpha) makes all capacity curves exactly symmetric about alpha=0.5 (confirmed numerically, fig2_cluster_scan_pbc_symmetric.csv), contradicting the paper's asymmetric Fig. 2; OBC spectral widths 10.83/7.24 at alpha=0/1 and alpha=1 edge zero modes match Fig. S1c (verify_formulas.py::check_cluster_gap)

cards.numerical_form: Dense 2^L x 2^L Pauli-string construction; cluster chain OPEN (paper convention, resolved empirically); TFIM fully connected.

cards.title: Ridge readout and NMSE
cards.role: Macroscopic task benchmark (green dashed curves in Fig. 2a and Fig. S2c); eta = 1e-5; features = full Pauli-basis expectation values.
cards.numerical_form: Standard ridge regression on training-window features; prediction target s_{n+h}.
open_questions: Whether a constant bias feature is included is not stated; assumed included.

cards.title: Markovian bound on coherent dissipation
cards.role: Negative coherent dissipation is only possible for non-Markovian drives (like Mackey-Glass); underlies the quantum-advantage claim of Fig. 2c.
derived_from: convexity of the relative entropy of coherence applied to the causal mixture S57

checks.reason: C(sum q_i rho_i) <= sum q_i C(rho_i) on random mixtures (verify_formulas.py::check_coherence_convexity)

cards.numerical_form: Not used directly in code; interpretive bound for the sign of D_q.
